Use case: stylized-concept
Create ONE cohesive pixel-art art-direction review board for Runic Storage, a Core Keeper mod. This is a concept board, not a sprite sheet or validated game assets.
Reference image 1 is CURRENT art: preserve tier colors and crystal-in-metal-socket identity, and use the terminal (top row second object) as the family anchor. Reference image 2 is approved style inspiration: deliberate large pixel clusters, elevated three-quarter view, warm upper-left planes, cool colored shadows, restrained tones, appealing chunky form.
Charcoal background, clean generous spacing, landscape board. Title "RUNIC STORAGE — GEM CONCEPTS". Eight equally sized cells in two rows of four, each with a prominent very low-resolution-looking gem and a smaller readability rendition. Exact labels in order: "TIN", "IRON", "SCARLET", "OCTARINE", "GALAXITE", "SOLARITE", "PANDORIUM", "RELUCITE". Footer "Concept study • native-pixel cleanup follows".
Design all as compact upgrade crystals in small related metal sockets, aimed at eventual 16x16 icons; visible top facets, simple chunky silhouettes, no fine engraving. Keep original progression, avoid unrelated jewelry or trophies.
TIN: pale ice-blue squat chunky crystal, simple pewter cup and tiny brass fastener.
IRON: dark navy square-cut gem, sturdy iron corner clamps, one broad blue highlight.
SCARLET: red upright diamond crystal, copper-dark mount, small split fork retaining prongs.
OCTARINE: broad teal asymmetric hexagonal crystal, muted dark teal socket with one tiny warm-gold stud.
GALAXITE: purple two-point crystal cluster, dark socket with a single gold crescent-like retaining band.
SOLARITE: amber golden broad crystal, bronze socket, a simple stepped sunlike shoulder shape.
PANDORIUM: cobalt-blue slender angular crystal, dark blue metal mount, a pale diagonal facet and compact prongs.
RELUCITE: hot pink/magenta two-point crystal with one offset side shard, violet socket with a small pale metal accent.
Art should feel like enlarged authentic low-resolution inventory art, roughly 12-16 purposeful square pixel steps across an icon, few large facets, 3-4 tones per material. No smooth gradients, antialiasing, realistic gemstone rendering, tiny glitter, broad glow, outlines uniformly black, elaborate filigree, or excessively detailed bases. Shared scale and coherent family, visibly different silhouettes. No workbench or storage units on this board.
workbench: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one pixel-art concept board for a replacement RUNIC STORAGE WORKBENCH in Core Keeper. Reference 1 shows current mod art: terminal is top row second item, orange copper lower cabinet, dark tilted screen with teal markings. User likes that terminal; design a matching craft station, not a replacement terminal. Reference 2 approved Hemlock board supplies chunky deliberate pixel clusters, elevated three-quarter camera and warm upper-left light, cool hue-tinted shadow. Charcoal background. Title "RUNIC STORAGE — WORKBENCH". One primary design prominently centered left and a small readability rendition right, labeled "Crystal-setting workbench"; footer "Concept study • native-pixel cleanup follows". Compact square one-tile crafting bench with visible broad top and short sturdy legs, aged copper corner braces, muted blue-gray stone worktop, dark wood support, ONE inset teal crystal socket and ONE short hammer on the tabletop. Lower front has a simple copper panel with a subtle teal diamond rune. Keep the top uncluttered so it reads at eventual 16x16 main and 16x20 side dimensions. Slight asymmetry from the hammer, strong silhouette, tangible tabletop thickness and shadow underneath. Match the terminal's warm copper and localized teal accent, do not introduce a computer display, large furnace, tall crystal tower, or elaborate altar. Aim for roughly 16 large square pixel steps across its width; truly chunky shapes, 3-4 tones per material, colored dark edges, no smooth gradients, no glow haze, no dither, no fine decorative clutter. This is a design concept, not a validated sprite or game screenshot.
